note: PROTOTYPE — the one editor's key bindings, as data (architecture.md §5): change a key here, not in code. The player keys — Space, ← →, J K L — are every player's and live in @workspace/shared/navigation. Logging and brick editing are one window (David, 2026-11-06): I sets an in point and, pressed again while that brick is open, moves it; O closes the brick and, pressed again, moves its out point; a brick picked by Tab or a tap is the one I and O move. B and E go to the brick's first and last frame; [ ] step the in point and , . the out point by word (Shift: a frame). = and - zoom the strip around the playhead and \ fits it. Shift is read by the action itself: Shift+I/O marks the exact playhead, Shift+Tab selects the previous brick, Shift+Esc redoes. S toggles showing each brick's action.
